description: Per-order immutable consent receipt for 要配慮個人情報 (APPI 第2条第3項 / 個人情報保護法 / GDPR Art. 9 special category / HIPAA PHI equivalent) transfer to an external clinical laboratory or to iyashi internal phlebotomy. Binds 1:1 to a `mitate.diagnosticOrder` via `orderRefCid`. Per ADR-2605281950 GC (mandatory, non-back-datable, revocable until 30d after result delivery) + ADR-2605181100 (encrypted envelope substrate) + ADR-2605260100 G7 (sealed-recipient set structurally excludes insurance / employer / advertiser / state-aligned entities). Template version is annually reviewed by chigiri (ADR-2605262700) per ADR-2605281950 §D2.

patientPseudonymDid.description: 30-day-rotating mitate patient pseudonym DID. Distinct from `consentingAdherentDid` (the underlying Adherent SBT signer). Reinforces ADR-2605260100 G2 (mitate sealed-recipient set).

orderRefCid.description: Binds 1:1 to a `mitate.diagnosticOrder` record. Validators MUST verify the bound order's `consentReceiptCid` resolves back to this receipt.

templateVersion.description: Semver of the chigiri-stewarded consent template (`major.minor.patch`). Template changes require chigiri annual review (ADR-2605281950 GC).

jurisdictions.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-3. Permitted patient jurisdiction(s) + receiving lab jurisdiction. Cross-border consent surfaces (multiple values) trigger chigiri multi-juris review path.

senderRecipientDids.description: Sealed-recipient registry. Permitted DID prefixes: patient passkey DID, licensed MD attestor DID (`did:web:etzhayyim.com:mitate:physician:*`), receiving external lab DID (must be in EXTERNAL_LAB_DID_REGISTRY), Council medical advisory DIDs. EXCLUDED by structural enforcement (ADR-2605260100 G7 + ADR-2605281950 GD): insurance / employer / advertiser / state-aligned entities.

dataCategoriesShared.description: Per ADR-2605281950 §D2. At R2 the categories `family-history` / `genetic-marker` are NOT permitted (out of scope per N1, N3). Extension requires Council Lv7+ unanimity per non-goal status.

revocableUntilUtc.description: Hard revocation deadline. Default: result delivery + 30 days. Revocation triggers downstream deletion request to external lab DID; per ADR-2605281950 GC.

consentingAdherentDid.description: Patient's underlying Adherent SBT DID. Distinct from `patientPseudonymDid`; signature surface for the consent receipt.
